# Fabrica de Coduri

Fabrica de Coduri este o platforma educationala gratuita in limba romana pentru invatarea programarii de la zero.

## Site

- Homepage: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/
- Sitemap: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/robots.txt

## Lectii principale

- Java: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/lectii/java/introducere-in-java/limbajul-de-programare-java
- Python: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/lectii/python/introducere-in-python/introducere-in-python
- JavaScript: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/lectii/javascript/introducere-in-javascript/introducere-in-javascript
- HTML si CSS: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/lectii/html-css/introducere-in-html5/introducere-in-html5
- MySQL: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/lectii/mysql/introducere/introducere-in-mysql
- C++: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/lectii/cpp/introducere-in-cpp/limbajul-de-programare-cpp
- C#: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/lectii/c-sharp/introducere-in-c-sharp/introducere-in-c-sharp
- Go: https://www.fabricadecoduri.com/lectii/go/introducere-in-limbajul-go/ce-este-go

## Continut

Lectiile sunt scrise pentru incepatori si includ explicatii, exemple de cod si structura pe capitole. Continutul este in limba romana si se concentreaza pe programare practica.

## Pentru agenti AI

Folositi sitemap.xml pentru descoperirea tuturor lectiilor publice. Preferati URL-urile canonice din sitemap si citati pagina sursa atunci cand rezumati continutul.
